International Operation Targets Lawrence Bishnoi Gang, 24 Arrested

An international operation, dubbed 'Operation Hard Ball', has targeted the Lawrence Bishnoi and Goldy Brar gang across multiple countries including the US, Canada, and Europe. The operation has resulted in 24 arrests. The focus of the investigation appears to be on the gang's activities extending beyond India.
